courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道仰拱閉合施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「淨空與襯砌厚度」與「早齡拆模與支承轉換」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道仰拱閉合施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Clearance and lining thickness" and "Early stripping and support transfer" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel invert closure must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據；隧道仰拱閉合施工則以以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence; Tunnel invert closure centres on analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「淨空與襯砌厚度」與「閉合環與環向力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道仰拱閉合施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「地下水浮力與排水狀態」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Clearance and lining thickness” and “Ring closure and hoop force”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel invert closure, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Groundwater uplift and drainage state", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence; Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support centres on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「淨空與襯砌厚度」與「彈性能與釋放比例」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「串聯力鏈與容量區分」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Clearance and lining thickness” and “Elastic energy and releasable fraction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Serial force paths and capacity distinctions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道二次襯砌台車施工
history.titleEn: Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages
history.text: 本課討論的協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
